source_evidence: Exact player 'Maybe redo the gnoll encounter to see if this works' authorizes a narrow correction of the unengaged Day331 encounter selection and circumstances to demonstrate RANDOM-ENCOUNTER-BREADTH-D331-001. Preserve every accepted travel, rest, communication, supply and resource result; do not replay occurrence9/type56/severity17, count an additional encounter, advance time, or erase original immutable chunk. Only its five-gnoll roster/initial sighting is superseded by this one replacement. Before selection, DM prepared the 27 weighted creature-group/activity candidates in selection_table below from nine 2014-family sourcebooks, campaign context (western Ossent temperate wooded hills, rough cartway, shaded rocky cuts), and candidate library @cc07d27238d415112b8f8fa52dafc700d81438d6; provisional relative weights 6/3/1 are design assumptions, not a census or new population canon. Actual visible Python secrets receipt batch22c19be77726e02186468edee7137ee4 d81 face47 maps row12 range46–48 Dolgaunt and dolgrims (ERLW): aberrant foraging party emerging from hillside refuge, hunting surface prey. They fit type56's organized predator alternative even though their printed creature type is aberration. No redraw for desired outcome. Exact complete statblocks read in 5etools mirror data/bestiary/bestiary-erlw.json blob5a16d86a3175eaeb333dec8900ee67a25c100d6f, ERLW pp290–291, no _copy or template. One Dolgaunt CR3 (700XP), two Dolgrims CR1/2 (100 each) =900base×2=1800 adjusted XP for three combat characters, below 2250 medium threshold, consistent with manageable band. Composition chosen by DM within the fixed selected group/severity, not an additional rolled result. New local ecology: a finite three-creature aberrant hunting band inhabits a rocky hillside refuge, pursuing surface prey; no imported Eberron/Daelkyr nation, deity, specific plane, fresh portal, canon biological crossbreeding, named faction or ancestry link. Existing source/campaign lore allows Convergence-adapted populations. At same Day331~11:00 roughly5/12 rough miles, Mara stops coach on same general hill track, after hearing disturbance below the road. Visible downhill rocky hollow on right is about10ft lower than cartway; rough scrubbed slope between, difficult terrain off track; rock outcrops and trunks provide actual cover where applicable; road not blocked, route back open and road ahead physically passable at this instant. A dead deer lies near a dark rock fissure at ~65ft from nearest edge of coach/party group. An eyeless, sinewy dolgaunt with long shoulder tentacles stands near deer, two squat four-armed, two-mouthed dolgrims with shield and weapons accompany it. Fixed initial positions relative to road edge nearest halted coach: dolgaunt roughly65ft downhill, dolgrim A roughly55ft downhill/right, dolgrim B roughly75ft near fissure; sightlines unobstructed at initial visible positions, nearby rocks/trees permit cover by actual movement, no automatic cover for all. Exact PC combat squares to establish before initiative according to actual actions. Dolgaunt's 120ft blindsight can detect exposed coach/party within range; no through-wall sensing. Dolgrim A looks at horses and barks to companions. Band hostile/opportunistic toward potential prey; no attack, forced movement, surprise, initiative, chase, captive rescue or quest imposed. Fenar observes strange creatures, Mara holds reins, Cirren readies shield. V has not moved, spoken, acted or spent anything, may fight, keep driving, retreat or otherwise respond. Day/time, encounter caps, purse, provisions and all pools remain unchanged. No D331 day consumption or current night rest yet. Original encounter sighting is audit-only to extent superseded; original journey/rest and raw prior dice remain valid and must be applied exactly once. New checkpoint replaces only encounter setup.
